description: Ministry of Transport - Temporary Extension of the Validity Period of Driving Licence
categorisation: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Transport under the Motor Traffic Act, specifically amending the validity period of driving licenses. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and legal amendments to existing regulations. While it mentions a government minister (Gamini Lokuge), it does not contain detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes, making it primarily a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or organizational gazette.
